title: Fix 4 Unicode bugs in Rust text-stats library
description: The rust_text_stats library has 4 buggy functions — char_count counts bytes instead of chars, is_palindrome doesn't normalize, count_vowels misses uppercase, and char_truncate uses byte offsets. All 6 tests currently fail.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 4 buggy functions in src/lib.rs. All 6 tests must pass after your fixes.

1. char_count(s): use s.chars().count() instead of s.len()
2. is_palindrome(s): normalize by lowercasing and removing non-alphanumeric chars before comparing
3. count_vowels(s): use c.to_ascii_lowercase() so uppercase vowels are counted
4. char_truncate(s, max_len): use char_indices to find the correct byte boundary for the nth char

Do not modify the test file. Run cargo test to confirm all 6 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `cargo test` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
